## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 3/11 sectors positive; Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology) in the Top 5. Confirmations: shallow sector breadth plus major divergence across large caps (multiple 1W/1M mismatches) justify a neutral stance.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Technology leads: META (1W: +11.45% | 1M: +35.91%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +7.78% | 1M: +4.97%) ABOVE TREND. Healthcare showing relative strength: JNJ (1W: +1.18% | 1M: +1.28%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +2.34% | 1M: -6.39%) RECOVERY. Industrials have pockets of strength: ETN (1W: +10.75% | 1M: +4.85%) ABOVE TREND, CAT (1W: +4.15% | 1M: +0.14%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Communication weakest: VZ (1W: -7.04% | 1M: -3.07%) BELOW TREND, CMCSA (1W: -7.84% | 1M: -13.21%) BELOW TREND. Energy lagging: OXY (1W: -7.33% | 1M: -6.51%) BELOW TREND, XOM (1W: -4.11% | 1M: -4.72%) BELOW TREND. Financials mixed with sector negative despite pockets: JPM (1W: +0.55% | 1M: +0.14%) ABOVE TREND while overall Financials 1W -1.56%.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: INTC (1W: +25.30% | 1M: +32.18%) ABOVE TREND; AMD (1W: +24.75% | 1M: +31.11%) ABOVE TREND; META (1W: +11.45% | 1M: +35.91%) ABOVE TREND; ETN (1W: +10.75% | 1M: +4.85%) ABOVE TREND; LRCX (1W: +10.53% | 1M: -2.66%) RECOVERY. Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology) — caution on concentration.

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: CHTR (1W: -13.95% | 1M: -16.52%) BELOW TREND; INTU (1W: -10.33% | 1M: -15.96%) BELOW TREND; TMUS (1W: -9.64% | 1M: -8.28%) BELOW TREND; NFLX (1W: -8.67% | 1M: -8.46%) BELOW TREND; CVS (1W: -8.32% | 1M: -6.46%) BELOW TREND. Weakness concentrated in Communication and select software names.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Best 1W momentum: INTC (1W: +25.30% | 1M: +32.18%) ABOVE TREND; AMD (1W: +24.75% | 1M: +31.11%) ABOVE TREND; META (1W: +11.45% | 1M: +35.91%) ABOVE TREND; LRCX (1W: +10.53% | 1M: -2.66%) RECOVERY. Note major divergence set: several large caps show 1W vs 1M mismatches (LRCX, AMAT, ASML, CRM, MSFT) — tactical, not broad confirmation.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Tech is the focal point: AAPL (1W: +1.77% | 1M: +8.89%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +7.78% | 1M: +4.97%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +25.30% | 1M: +32.18%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: -0.75% | 1M: +4.25%) CORRECTION, LRCX (1W: +10.53% | 1M: -2.66%) RECOVERY. Sector showing leadership but narrow concentration; Tech 1W: +3.69% (24 stocks) and is one of only three positive sectors.

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Financials mixed: JPM (1W: +0.55% | 1M: +0.14%) ABOVE TREND while MA (1W: -1.18% | 1M: -1.08%) BELOW TREND and V (1W: -1.42% | 1M: +1.15%) CORRECTION. Sector 1W: -1.56% with internal dispersion; style tilt shows Growth/Momentum leadership but Financials currently lack broad confirmation.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Healthcare is modestly positive: JNJ (1W: +1.18% | 1M: +1.28%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +2.34% | 1M: -6.39%) RECOVERY, UNH (1W: -1.56% | 1M: -1.29%) BELOW TREND. Sector 1W: +1.12% but watch idiosyncratic news catalysts driving moves.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Favor selective exposure to current leaders (INTC, AMD, META) while reducing exposure to structurally weak Communication and some Energy names (TMUS, CMCSA, OXY). Style: Growth/Momentum tilt but narrow leadership — prioritize names with confirmed multi-timeframe strength and monitor divergence for trend breaks.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: INTC (1W: +25.30% | 1M: +32.18%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +24.75% | 1M: +31.11%) ABOVE TREND, META (1W: +11.45% | 1M: +35.91%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: TMUS (1W: -9.64% | 1M: -8.28%) BELOW TREND, CMCSA (1W: -7.84% | 1M: -13.21%) BELOW TREND, CHTR (1W: -13.95% | 1M: -16.52%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Technology (1W: +3.69% | 1M: +6.00%) — leadership concentrated; Healthcare (1W: +1.12% | 1M: -2.52%) for idiosyncratic catalysts. BEARISH: Communication (1W: -5.14% | 1M: -5.47%), Energy (1W: -2.43% | 1M: +0.96%).

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
NVDA (1W: +7.78% | 1M: +4.97%) ABOVE TREND — watch hold above this week's breakout for continuation. INTC (1W: +25.30% | 1M: +32.18%) ABOVE TREND — monitor follow-through after the large gap for confirmation. TMUS (1W: -9.64% | 1M: -8.28%) BELOW TREND — watch for further breakdown below recent lows as risk trigger.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
WBD (+85): Paramount merger legal clearance headline; WBD (1W: +9.61% | 1M: +9.10%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed by price. META (+50): large positive narrative around market cap lift; META (1W: +11.45% | 1M: +35.91%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed. AMD (+50): positive narrative on valuation; AMD (1W: +24.75% | 1M: +31.11%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
TMUS (-50): JPM cut/softness headline; TMUS (1W: -9.64% | 1M: -8.28%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirmed. NFLX (-50): downgrade headlines; NFLX (1W: -8.67% | 1M: -8.46%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirmed. INTC (-50): CEO fulfillment concerns in headlines but stock is rallying; INTC (1W: +25.30% | 1M: +32.18%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment diverging from price, watch for distribution.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL with a Growth/Momentum tilt; Breadth: 3/11 sectors positive and Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology). META (1W: +11.45% | 1M: +35.91%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +25.30% | 1M: +32.18%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +24.75% | 1M: +31.11%) ABOVE TREND are showing strength. Key risk is major divergence across large caps (LRCX, AMAT, ASML, CRM, MSFT mismatches) and mixed news sentiment (INTC/BA negative headlines vs strong price) — monitor for trend breaks.
